name: Compute Kernel — Phase 1: Data Plane
description: Implement the data plane of the Tribunus Compute Kernel: storage handles, tensor views, shape/stride/dtype metadata, shared/device/pinned allocation classes, buffer pools, explicit materialization boundaries, and copy-honesty receipts proving whether operations copied or stayed as views.
purpose: Establish the governed memory substrate. Every logical view, materialization, migration, and plugin-visible buffer grant must be explicit and receipted.
acceptanceCriteria: Storage handles with tracked allocation classes (shared/device/pinned)
Tensor views with shape, stride, and dtype metadata validation
Buffer pools for efficient reuse with explicit lifecycle
Materialization receipts distinguish copies from zero-copy views
Plugin-visible buffer grants are scoped and receipted
No opaque access to raw accelerator memory from plugins or agents
Metal backend for Apple Silicon as first target
